one_liner: LinkedIn Advertising API for managing marketing campaigns, ad accounts, and analytics.
auth_notes: Uses OAuth 2.0 for user authorization and API authentication.
gate_notes: Requires creating an app, adding the Advertising API product, and completing an access form which LinkedIn reviews.
verdict_reason: LinkedIn Ads provides a robust Marketing/Advertising REST API under OAuth 2.0, but access requires submitting an application form and getting approval from LinkedIn.

evidence.quote: 1. Create an app, add Advertising API, and complete the access form under My Apps > select your app > Products. · 2. LinkedIn will review your application
The LinkedIn API uses OAuth 2.0 for user authorization and API authentication.
